systems.system: Starlink satellite internet at Murang'a public health facilities
systems.owner: Murang'a County Government, with Paratus Group as installer and service provider
systems.tiers: all 170 public health facilities of Murang'a County; nearby schools, churches and institutions may subscribe through the county

note: The connection stated is at the county's 170 public health facilities, launched 28 May 2026, not at the county government's own offices; no typology class fits a health-facility connection, so class is left empty and no fact is taken.
